top_signals.title: Paramount ‘Highly Confident’ In Warner Bros. Deal
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Hannah Miller joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." A federal judge temporarily paused Paramount Skydance’s $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery  saying it “likely” violates antitrust law. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Says Ex-Goldman Banker Berko Paid a ‘Holy Rain’ of Bribes
top_signals.summary: A former Goldman Sachs Group Inc. banker went on trial for allegedly bribing government officials in Ghana to secure a lucrative power plant deal for a client.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: BNY to bring transfer agency records onchain in blockchain push
top_signals.summary: BNY is launching a blockchain-based transfer agency platform as the bank expands its digital asset infrastructure and moves core financial records onchain.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
